scope: Source provenance, dataset licensing, ethics/declaration handoff, and immutable-release preparation without publishing a release.

controls.source_authority_rule: A public mirror or repository license does not establish upstream authorship or license rights. Byte identity, source authenticity, license terms, redistribution permission, and citation authority are recorded separately.
controls.unknown_rule: Unknown or unresolved legal, ethics, authorship, and release fields remain explicit and are never inferred from hashes, public visibility, or repository metadata.

primary_source.record_title: Employee Performance Analysis: INX Future Inc., Project 10281
primary_source.evidence: The official three-page project brief names the dataset URL and states that the scenario is not based on an actual organization. The live dataset endpoint reports the same byte length as the local workbook, but the upstream file was not automatically downloaded, so exact upstream-to-local byte identity is not established.

license.evidence: The official project brief states all rights reserved and that reproduction of the material requires IABAC permission. Whether and how that notice applies to redistribution of the linked workbook requires author/legal confirmation.

datasets.citation_text: IABAC. Employee Performance Analysis: INX Future Inc., Project 10281, document CDS_Project_2_INX_Future_Emp_Data_V1.6 (2017). https://iabac.org/exam/p2/CDS_Project_2_INX_Future_Emp_Data_V1.6.pdf (accessed 2026-09-07).
datasets.public_release_policy: Exclude both raw files; publish hashes, schema, acquisition instructions, and aggregate evidence only.
datasets.unresolved: Obtain written redistribution permission or an authoritative dataset-specific license and independently bind the local workbook bytes to the authorized source.

primary_source.evidence: The author record names Dr. Carla Patalano and Dr. Rich Huebner, identifies version 14, describes a fictitious company and author-created teaching data, and provides the license statement and codebook.

mirror.evidence: The local file is byte-identical under Git blob hashing to this immutable mirror commit. The mirror has no repository license and does not prove the byte identity of the authors' Kaggle version.

license.evidence: The authors' Kaggle description grants learning/teaching use and directs sharing under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. The license permits sharing with attribution for noncommercial use but prohibits distribution of adapted material.

datasets.citation_text: Huebner, R.; Patalano, C. Human Resources Data Set, Version 14. Kaggle. https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/rhuebner/human-resources-data-set (accessed 2026-09-07).
datasets.public_release_policy: Exclude raw data until the exact authors' version is byte-bound and noncommercial/no-derivatives redistribution compliance is approved; publish hashes, acquisition instructions, schema, and aggregates only.
datasets.unresolved: Bind the local bytes to an author-controlled v14 artifact and obtain author/legal confirmation that the intended archive and any transformations satisfy attribution, noncommercial, and no-derivatives conditions.

datasets.public_release_policy: Exclude raw data pending IBM/uploader rights-chain and ODbL/DbCL compliance review; publish hashes, acquisition instructions, schema, and aggregates only.

primary_source.authority: Historical Kaggle locator; SAS documentation provides secondary provenance
primary_source.evidence: The historical Kaggle locator is cited by SAS documentation, which describes HR_comma_sep.csv as simulated data. The original record is no longer publicly retrievable through the tested page/API, so its authorship and license cannot be verified.

mirror.evidence: The local file is byte-identical under Git blob hashing to this immutable mirror commit. The mirror has no repository license, and other mirrors assign conflicting licenses; none is accepted as upstream authority.

license.evidence: No accessible authoritative license statement was verified. Licenses attached to third-party copies conflict and do not establish upstream rights.

datasets.citation_text: Human Resources Analytics / HR_comma_sep.csv. Historical Kaggle locator: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/ludobenistant/hr-analytics (unavailable when checked 2026-09-07); provenance corroborated only by SAS documentation.
datasets.public_release_policy: Exclude raw data; publish hashes, the immutable mirror locator, schema, aggregate results, and the unresolved source/license warning only.
datasets.unresolved: Identify the original author/owner, recover an authoritative license and citation record, and bind the local bytes to that record before any redistribution.

blockers.item: Author contributions/CRediT roles are not approved.

Conflict-of-interest declarations are not approved by all authors.
AI/tool-use disclosure requires author and target-journal policy review.
No raw dataset has a complete authoritative source-to-local-byte and redistribution-rights chain.
The public repository has no detected software LICENSE; authors must select or explicitly decline one.
Five raw dataset paths remain in public Git history; remediation/disclosure needs separate authorization and coordination.

No GitHub release, archival deposit, release URL, or DOI exists.

release_plan.allowed_payload: Tracked source, configuration, tests, manuscript, and validated compact aggregate evidence at the final approved commit.
release_plan.excluded_payload: Raw/interim employee records, row-level predictions or SHAP values, fold/training partitions, fitted models/calibrators, secrets, caches, environments, and unlicensed local evidence.
steps: Resolve author, ethics, software-license, dataset-rights, and Git-history decisions.
Freeze and obtain user approval for the final v3 claim matrix.
Rewrite and validate the manuscript, response package, declarations, figures, tables, and final review simulation.
Run full tests, independent package validators, repository hygiene, link, manifest, and manuscript render checks on a clean candidate commit.
Record the exact final commit in the release candidate manifest; create the proposed tag only on that commit after explicit authorization.
Publish a GitHub release only after explicit authorization and verify its immutable URL and attached artifact hashes.
Connect or upload the authorized release to Zenodo/OSF; reserve or mint a DOI through the archive UI; then record only the returned identifiers and URLs.
Update citation metadata and manuscript data/code-availability statements with the verified tag, commit, release URL, and DOI, followed by a final integrity pass.

prohibited_assertions: all raw data may be redistributed
source authenticity is proven by hashes
the final tag exists on GitHub
the current mutable branch is the final reproducibility reference
